method.scope: Exploratory descriptive associations; no hypothesis tests, p-values, prediction or causal estimates.
method.grain: Country x hire quarter for unemployment/B-F; country x hire year for CPI.
method.exposure: Mean of employee-specific as-of values among matched mature hires; a cohort exposure summary, not a newly measured economic period value. Source frequency/period/vintage remain in joined audit.
method.weighting: Each cohort receives equal weight in correlations; exposure means within cohorts are employee-weighted.
method.dependence: Cohorts can reuse source periods/vintages. Neither employee count nor cohort count is an independent economic sample size.
method.uncertainty: No inferential intervals because repeated observations and only six countries make naive independence assumptions inappropriate. Report leave-one-country-out and minimum-size sensitivity, not confidence intervals.
method.confounding: Within-country centering removes country mean differences only; calendar trends, composition, selection, and omitted factors remain. Breakdown tables expose country/year/business-unit selection.
method.multiple_comparisons: All three preselected available indicators and both required retention populations are reported, including weak/unstable patterns. No significance-based selection.
method.turnover: Deferred relationship estimation: one annual window and six country contexts do not support a credible repeated-period analysis. Snapshot KPI/coverage remain valid.
method.threshold: Minimum 10 mature matched hires is an exploratory stability check, not a guarantee of reliability.
method.vacancies: B-F supplementary sector measure only. Preferred B-N has no verified historical matches.
